doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Ory's birth date and Laplace origins
summary: Asked about Oliver's age, Ory gives his birth date (Dec 25, 1886), his birthplace in St. John Parish, and talk of Pops Foster's origin.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Oh, I was wondering about Mutt. Was Mutt ever in the Army? Did he go in the Army, do you think? No, I don't think so. Oh, and I was interested before, when you said he was older than you, Mr. O'Reilly. Yeah. What was...
I think he missed, he just skipped it.
Yeah, I never did know his age. What was your birth date? If you don't mind giving it, then we'll have it straight on here.
My birthday? Christmas Day, December 25th. Born 1886. 1886. That's right.
Well, Laplace. Laplace, that's what I say. And St. John's... St. John's parish. St. John's
St. John's Parish and the next parish is St. James Wilman Brodlip was born in St. James Parish
Did Pops Foster come from he came from Plaquemine
I'm not sure He wasn't up in your neighborhood Pops Foster didn't come from that part of the country No
